en.text:
<arc/>Arc Staff hits now apply <arc/>Jolt.

Hits with <arc/>Arc Staff grant a Stack of 'Synapse Junctions' for 5 seconds. Maximum of 3 Stacks.

Damage increases | Passive Super Drain decreases:
• Synapse Junctions x1: 27% | 20%
• Synapse Junctions x2: 61% | 40%
• Synapse Junctions x3: 105% | 60% 

<arc/>Arc Staff's Heavy Palm Blast (Light->Light->Heavy) recieves a higher damage bonus, dealing 40%|96%|174% increased damage at 1|2|3 stacks of Synapse Junctions.
